events.subtitle: Poisonous Weapons Tour
events.factual_description: I.M.P. presents Mastodon with Deafheaven and Alcest at The Anthem in Washington, DC on Friday, September 25, 2026. Doors are at 5:30 PM and the show is at 7:00 PM. Ticketmaster independently confirms the same date, show time and venue. Mastodon's official store identifies the current U.S. run as the Poisonous Weapons Tour, while Mastodon's official site and Apple Music identify Marrow Deep as the band's new album, scheduled for release on August 28, 2026. Deafheaven's current album is Lonely People With Power and Alcest's most recent album is Les Chants de l'Aurore.

en.why_it_matters: The reason to care is the bill itself: Mastodon, Deafheaven and Alcest represent three different ways of stretching heavy music beyond genre orthodoxy. Mastodon builds weight through progressive riff architecture and rhythmic muscle; Deafheaven lets black-metal velocity collide with shoegaze scale and atmosphere; Alcest helped turn that atmospheric borderland into a language of its own. With Mastodon also entering the Marrow Deep cycle, the Anthem date has a current-project reason to matter rather than reading as a legacy-heavy package.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for this one in the DMV if progressive, heavy and experimental music are part of the listening thread. The specific three-band package is strong enough to build the night around locally, while the multi-city tour routing means there is no need to treat Washington as a scarce regional one-off.

es.why_it_matters: Aquí importa el cartel completo: Mastodon, Deafheaven y Alcest representan tres maneras distintas de empujar la música pesada fuera de sus fronteras más obvias. Mastodon construye peso desde arquitectura de riffs progresivos y músculo rítmico; Deafheaven hace chocar la velocidad del black metal con la escala y la atmósfera del shoegaze; Alcest ayudó a convertir justamente esa frontera atmosférica en un lenguaje propio. Además, Mastodon entra a esta gira con Marrow Deep como ciclo nuevo, así que la fecha de The Anthem tiene una razón actual para importar y no funciona sólo como paquete de legado.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente dentro del DMV si el hilo de escucha incluye prog, metal y música pesada experimental. El cartel de tres bandas alcanza para construir la noche alrededor del show localmente; al ser parte de una gira de varias ciudades, no hace falta tratar Washington como un one-off regional escaso.
